reason: The hypothesis relies on Hf effects observed in FCC HEAs and superalloys, but the cited evidence does not directly support the application of these mechanisms to the BCC NbMoTaW system, nor does it address high-temperature performance or irradiation resistance.
premises: Hf addition improves room-temperature ductility in single-phase FCC HEAs via precipitation of intermetallic compounds
Hf is an essential alloying element for interface strengthening in superalloys and Ni-Al B2 phase
The mechanism of solution strengthening and interface strengthening from Hf-rich precipitates applies to NbMoTaW
Small Hf additions do not significantly reduce ductility
